mentions.name: 401k.live
mentions.description: A public dataset and web tool for exploring 50,000+ 401(k) plans holding $7.5T in total assets. Users can look inside a company's plan, such as Google, to see what employees invest in (e.g., mostly 2035-2055 target date funds) and how much they contribute (e.g., $30K, likely via Mega Backdoor Roth).
mentions.source_excerpt:
Public dataset for exploring 50,000+ 401(k) plans holding $7.5T in assets.

You can look inside a company like Google and see what employees invest in (mostly 2035-2055 target date funds) or how much they contribute ($30K - likely using Mega Backdoor Roth)
